Adds examples/tpu/grpo/run_qwen3_30b_a3b_torchtitan.sh: GRPO on GSM8K with Qwen3-30B-A3B (128 experts, 8 active),
TorchTitan trainer and vLLM rollout on two TPU slices with tpu-sync weight sync. Defaults to TPU v7x 2x2x1 + 2x2x1,
like run_qwen3_5_torchtitan.sh; the README documents TPU v5p 2x2x4 + 2x2x4.

- Trainer: FSDP only over all trainer chips (TP 1, EP 1), SimpleFSDP + per-block compile + splash attention,
  DEFER_AND_FUSE. Packed micro-batches (use_dynamic_bsz, MAX_TOKEN_LEN_PER_GPU=8192) padded to
  engine_kwargs.tpu.seq_bucket_size=1024 for actor and ref: each micro-batch pays the FSDP all-gathers of all 30.5B
  parameters, so the budget fits a chip's share of a mini-batch in one micro-batch. Optional STATIC_MICRO_BATCH_LEN
  pads every micro-batch to one compiled shape.
- verl-hardware-plugin trainer options (verl-hardware-plugin#112): Splash attention blocks up to 1024
  (SPLASH_MAX_BLOCK_SIZE), torchtitan's paired W1/W3 Pallas expert kernel with kernel-native expert weights
  (MOE_PAIRED_GROUPED_MM, MOE_NATIVE_WEIGHT_LAYOUT); the plugin's fused Tokamax LM-head log-prob is required for MoE.
- Rollout: one vLLM replica per rollout host (ROLLOUT_TENSOR_PARALLEL_SIZE, default chips per host) with expert
  parallelism over its TP group (ROLLOUT_EXPERT_PARALLEL_SIZE, default TP), so every rank holds whole experts and the
  plugin's tpu-sync installs them directly.
- libtpu flags are appended to LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS (TPU pods may already set it): PROMOTE_F32 on v7x; on v5p a 64 MiB
  scoped VMEM limit and the async FSDP all-gather offloaded to the SparseCores.
- VERIFY_PARITY=off|norm|exact|all passed to engine_kwargs.tpu-sync.verify_parity; ENABLE_THINKING (default False),
  KL loss off by default.
- STAGE_MODEL=1 copies the checkpoint to local disk on every TPU host first (examples/tpu/grpo/stage_model_local.py):
  mmap of the safetensors over GCS Fuse is slow, a parallel copy is fast; complete copies are skipped and the CPU
  head only gets config / tokenizer files.
- README: file table rows and section 8 (requirements, v7x and v5p commands, the 4x batch preset, v5p timings).

Needs verl-hardware-plugin with Qwen3 MoE training support (verl-hardware-plugin#88) and its MoE trainer options
(verl-hardware-plugin#112).

Ports jialei777/verl-upstream#69 (run_qwen3_30b_a3b_torchtitan.sh, stage_model_local.py), #100 (packed
micro-batches, 1024 bucket) and #115 (v5p trainer perf, rollout replicas per host).

+#
+# GRPO | Qwen3-30B-A3B (MoE) | GSM8K | TorchTitan Training & vLLM Rollout | TPU: a trainer slice and a rollout slice
+# (default TPU v7x 2x2x1 + 2x2x1).
+# V1 PPOTrainer (Separate Async Overlap) - requires verl-hardware-plugin with Qwen3 MoE support and its MoE trainer
+# options (verl-hardware-plugin#88, #112).
+# See examples/tpu/grpo/README.md (Qwen3-30B-A3B on TPU) for full instructions.
+#
+# Qwen3-30B-A3B: 48 layers, hidden 2048, 128 experts (8 active per token, moe_intermediate_size 768);
+# 30.5B parameters, 3.3B active per token.
+#
+# Trainer: FSDP only (tensor parallel 1, expert parallel 1) over all trainer chips, as in torchtitan's FSDP-only
+# Qwen3-30B-A3B TPU recipe. fp32 params + grads + Adam m/v take 30.5B * 16 B / <trainer chips> per chip
+# (~61 GB on the 8 TensorCores of a v7x 2x2x1 slice, 96 GiB HBM each).
+# Rollout: one vLLM replica per rollout host (TP over the host's chips) and expert parallelism over the same group
+# (ROLLOUT_EP = ROLLOUT_TP, whole experts per rank). With 4 KV heads, TP4 holds one KV head per rank; on a multi-host
+# rollout slice several replicas generate in parallel (on v5p 2x2x4, 4 x TP4 instead of 1 x TP16 halved the GRPO step
+# at 128 prompts x 8). The tpu-sync weight sync installs every rank's experts directly into vLLM's fused expert
+# weights instead of going through vLLM's loaders (verl-hardware-plugin#89).
+
+set -xeuo pipefail
+
+export VERL_PLATFORM=tpu
+export VERL_USE_EXTERNAL_MODULES=verl_hardware_plugin
+export TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE="${TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE:-tpu7x}"
+export VERL_TPU_VLLM_ATTN_FP32_STATS=1
+export RAY_OVERRIDE_JOB_RUNTIME_ENV=1
+# RL timeline: per-step trainer / weight-sync / rollout spans and TPU HBM usage in the job log; verl-hardware-plugin's
+# profilers.make_report turns the log into an HTML report. Set VERL_TPU_TIMELINE=0 to turn it off.
+export VERL_TPU_TIMELINE="${VERL_TPU_TIMELINE:-1}"
+export RAY_memory_monitor_refresh_ms=0
+export RAY_memory_usage_threshold=0.99
+# libtpu flags (the plugin forwards LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS to the Ray workers):
+# - v7x: PROMOTE_F32 promotes sigmoid/SiLU/GELU to f32 (instead of bf16), for RL stability;
+# - v5p: 64 MiB scoped VMEM (vLLM's TensorCore MoE kernel needs it, see the README) and the async FSDP all-gather
+#   offloaded to the SparseCores (update_actor -2.7% on v5p 2x2x4 at 128 prompts x 8). Do not add
+#   --xla_tpu_enable_async_collective_fusion* / --xla_tpu_overlap_compute_collective_tc on top: together with these,
+#   libtpu fails to initialize.
+if [[ "${TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE}" == v5p* ]]; then
+    DEFAULT_LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS="--xla_tpu_use_enhanced_launch_barrier=false --xla_tpu_scoped_vmem_limit_kib=65536 --xla_enable_async_all_gather=true --xla_tpu_prefer_async_allgather_to_allreduce=true --xla_tpu_enable_sparse_core_collective_offload_all_gather=true"
+else
+    DEFAULT_LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS="--xla_tpu_use_enhanced_launch_barrier=false --xla_tpu_bf16_emission_mode=PROMOTE_F32"
+fi
+# Added to LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS (TPU pods may already set it, e.g. slice-builder flags) unless it sets the flag already.
+for flag in ${DEFAULT_LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS}; do
+    if [[ " ${LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS:-} " != *" ${flag%%=*}="* ]]; then
+        LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS="${LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS:+${LIBTPU_INIT_ARGS} }${flag}"
+    fi
+done

+exp_name="${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen3_30b_a3b_gsm8k_grpo}"

+

+"""Copy a HF checkpoint from a shared (GCS Fuse) path to the same local path on every alive TPU Ray node.
+
+TorchTitan's HF reader and vLLM mmap the safetensors shards. Over GCS Fuse those page faults can be very slow
+(~20 MB/s per host), while a parallel sequential copy runs at ~1 GB/s. Spot TPU slices are recreated with an empty
+host /tmp, so this runs before every job and skips nodes whose copy is already complete (same file names and sizes).
+
+Usage: python3 stage_model_local.py <src_dir> <dst_dir> [parallel_files]
+"""
+
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+
+import ray
+from ray.util.scheduling_strategies import NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy
+
+
+def _manifest(path: str) -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        f: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(path, f))
+        for f in os.listdir(path)
+        if not f.startswith(".") and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(path, f))
+    }
+
+
+_remote_manifest = ray.remote(num_cpus=0)(_manifest)
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_cpus=0)
+def _stage(src: str, dst: str, parallel: int, expected: dict[str, int], required: bool) -> str:
+    import socket
+    import subprocess
+
+    host = socket.gethostname()
+    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
+    have = _manifest(dst)
+    missing = [f for f, size in expected.items() if have.get(f) != size]
+    if not missing:
+        return f"{host}: already staged ({len(expected)} files)"
+    if not os.path.isdir(src):
+        if required:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"{host}: {src} does not exist on this node")
+        return f"{host}: {src} is not mounted here, skipped"
+    t0 = time.time()
+    procs = []
+    for f in missing:
+        while len(procs) >= parallel:
+            procs = [p for p in procs if p.poll() is None]
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+        procs.append(subprocess.Popen(["cp", os.path.join(src, f), os.path.join(dst, f)]))
+    for p in procs:
+        p.wait()
+    have = _manifest(dst)
+    failed = [f for f, size in expected.items() if have.get(f) != size]
+    if failed:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"{host}: staging incomplete, mismatched files: {failed}")
+    gb = sum(expected[f] for f in missing) / 1e9
+    dt = time.time() - t0
+    return f"{host}: copied {len(missing)} files ({gb:.1f} GB) in {dt:.0f}s ({gb / max(dt, 1e-3):.2f} GB/s)"
+
+
+def main():
+    src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
+    parallel = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 8
+    if os.path.abspath(src) == os.path.abspath(dst):
+        print(f"[stage_model_local] src == dst ({src}); nothing to do")
+        return
+    ray.init(address="auto", logging_level="ERROR")
+    alive = [n for n in ray.nodes() if n.get("Alive")]
+    tpu_nodes = [n for n in alive if n.get("Resources", {}).get("TPU", 0) > 0]
+    cpu_nodes = [n for n in alive if n.get("Resources", {}).get("TPU", 0) == 0]
+    if not tpu_nodes:
+        raise RuntimeError("no alive TPU nodes in the Ray cluster")
+
+    def on(node):
+        return NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy(node_id=node["NodeID"], soft=False)
+
+    # List the checkpoint on a TPU node: the driver (e.g. on a CPU head) may not mount the shared path.
+    expected = ray.get(_remote_manifest.options(scheduling_strategy=on(tpu_nodes[0])).remote(src))
+    if not any(f.endswith(".safetensors") for f in expected):
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no safetensors found in {src}")
+    # CPU-only nodes (e.g. the Ray head, where the TaskRunner builds HFModelConfig / the tokenizer from MODEL_PATH)
+    # only need the config, tokenizer and index files, not the weights; they are skipped if they do not mount src.
+    light = {f: size for f, size in expected.items() if not f.endswith((".safetensors", ".bin", ".pt"))}
+    print(
+        f"[stage_model_local] {src} -> {dst}: full copy on {len(tpu_nodes)} TPU nodes "
+        f"({sum(expected.values()) / 1e9:.1f} GB), config/tokenizer only on {len(cpu_nodes)} CPU nodes"
+    )
+    refs = [
+        _stage.options(scheduling_strategy=on(n)).remote(src, dst, parallel, files, required)
+        for nodes, files, required in ((tpu_nodes, expected, True), (cpu_nodes, light, False))
+        for n in nodes
+    ]
+    t0 = time.time()
+    for line in ray.get(refs):
+        print(f"[stage_model_local] {line}")
+    print(f"[stage_model_local] done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+(~20 MB/s per host), while a parallel sequential copy runs at ~1 GB/s. Spot TPU slices are recreated with an empty
+host /tmp, so this runs before every job and skips nodes whose copy is already complete (same file names and sizes).
+
+Usage: python3 stage_model_local.py <src_dir> <dst_dir> [parallel_files]
+"""
+
+import os

+import time
+
+import ray
+from ray.util.scheduling_strategies import NodeAffinitySchedulingStrategy
+
+
+def _manifest(path: str) -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        f: os.path.getsize(os.path.join(path, f))
+        for f in os.listdir(path)
+        if not f.startswith(".") and os.path.isfile(os.path.join(path, f))
+    }
+
+
+_remote_manifest = ray.remote(num_cpus=0)(_manifest)
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_cpus=0)
+def _stage(src: str, dst: str, parallel: int, expected: dict[str, int], required: bool) -> str:
+    import socket

+
+    host = socket.gethostname()
+    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
